liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Row Jimmy** (2 reviews): Listener describes the performance as dripping with emotion and very heavy; Listener describes the Row Jimmy performance as juking [14][20]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Listener recalls the Sugar Mag performance as particularly memorable [18]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Listener highlights the China/Rider transition and Rider as standout moments [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-06-25.142391.sbd.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 144 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1985-06-25.152625.akgc422-davis-murtha.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 22 songs; 144 min [3]
- **gd85-06-25.sbd.jeffm.3049.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 139 min; rated 4.18/5 by 28 [6]. Said about its sound: Listener praises the sweet sound quality of this specific copy; Listener notes the killer soundboard reveals the band's sloppiness [21][23]
- **gd1985-06-25.148520.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 22 songs; 138 min [9]
- **gd1985-06-25.140891.s1.unkown.Bryant.Miller.Noel.t-flac2496**: source not stated; 11 songs; 63 min [13]

## Around the show

- Listener missed the show due to work, but friends raved about Day Tripper and China Doll [16]
- Cuyahoga venue grounds were well cared for but unprepared for twenty thousand attendees [18]
- Listener prefers the Riverbend and Post shows from this tour over this one [17]
- Listener considers the show less great than Merriweather five nights later [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-06-25.142391.sbd.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassettes (dolby b) > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav… [1]
- **gd1985-06-25.152625.akgc422-davis-murtha.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew; Kenny Davis, Sean Murtha, Tom Pinney, Eddie Wahba; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Microphones: AKG C422|AKG S42 XY 90º Cardioid Recorder: Sony TC-D5M [mic master] Location: Pavilion ~100' from stage 30' ROC (Sec 22 Row R) This Source: Master… [3]
- **gd85-06-25.sbd.jeffm.3049.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Master Cassette> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN [6]
- **gd1985-06-25.148520.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [9]
- **gd1985-06-25.140891.s1.unkown.Bryant.Miller.Noel.t-flac2496**: taped by Robert Bryant; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Set 1 Robert Bryant recording: unknown mics > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M); Charlie Miller DSD [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Brian Baumwoll Grateful Dead: [1985-06-25 Blossom Music Center, Cuyahoga Falls, OH, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-06-25-blossom-music-center-cuyahoga-falls-oh-usa/) [27]
